name: claude-settings help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:claude-settings (the Claude plugin).
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Claude settings
entries.text: Opens Settings → Plugins → Claude: the settings every Claude session reads on axHub before it acts.

entries.title: Claude
entries.text: Claude's own settings: No wait, Follow Amber, builds, verification, talking, notifications and memory. Owner-only ones change only with your own click.

entries.title: Claude
entries.text: Every Claude setting in one page. They live on axHub, so voice, chat, Claude Code and headless agents all read the same values. Settings marked Owner only change only with your own click here.

entries.title: No wait
entries.text: Shows while No wait is on: Amber's held calls run at once instead of waiting on the 90 s veto. Turn off revokes the pass straight away.

entries.title: View
entries.text: How this page looks on this device: Tabs or Classic (one page). With tabs, pick the side they sit on and whether they show words, icons or both. Right-clicking the tab row changes the same thing.

entries.title: Approvals & veto
entries.text: What Amber can run at once, what waits on a veto and what needs your confirm, read live from axHub. Change a tool or a whole service, set its hold, or apply your default: only VPS writes and account switches hold. Only your own hub session can change these.

entries.title: Hold (seconds)
entries.text: How long a held call waits before it runs by itself, unless you deny it. 10 to 1800 seconds.

entries.title: Every tool here
entries.text: Sets every tool of this service to one choice. axHub's own rules still hold: destructive tools stay on confirm.

entries.title: Show tools
entries.text: Lists this service's tools, so you can set each one.

entries.title: Apply changes
entries.text: Applies your default on axHub: only VPS writes and account switches hold. It lists what changes and asks first. Destructive tools keep their confirm.

entries.title: Find a tool
entries.text: Filters the services below to the tools with this in their name.

entries.title: Tabs sit on the
entries.text: Which side the tabs sit on: top, bottom, left or right. Saved for this device.

entries.title: Tabs show
entries.text: What the tabs show: words, icons or both. Saved for this device.
